column3: if · The Forbidden Lily Chapter
Woahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!
I can't hold on any longer.
Honestly, making me use all that strength... Wait...
Y-You!!
...My life...
is over \(ωoω)/
...Kirino, sorry!
A-Ayase...?!
Sorry for the sudden intrusion. Although we didn't arrange to meet, I wanted to see you, so I came.
And Onii-san told me to wait for you since you were busy.
Sorry, sorry for saying such stuff.
Uh, okay. Hey, Ayase, did you happen to hear what I was doing...
Eh, what? Sorry. I was deep in a conversation with Onii-san, so I didn't hear a thing. It sounded like it was pretty bad, but because there was a wall
between us, so I couldn't hear it very well. For real. Yep.
But this wall isn't really sound-proof...
I didn't hear a thing.
Ah... Okay.
Then it's fine.
That's great. Then, let's go to your room?
Okay.
Onii-san, sorry for bothering you.
Yeah. I should be sorry for making you wait.
It's all right.
Ah... phew.
This is really... I can only let out a sigh.
How should I put it... this is tiring.
If Ayase didn't manage to defuse the situation when Kirino suddenly barged in, it would have been a terrible sight now.
...That was bad...
Aimlessly passing the time, hearing Kirino and Ayase's voices across the wall, I suddenly heard footsteps going towards the front door.
It seems like Ayase's about to leave.
I thought of sending her off, but Kirino would get angry, so never mind.
While having thoughts along these lines, Kirino came into the room without even knocking.
Hey!!!
...You get angry even without me showing my face.
Why did you bring her over on your own?
I don't understand what you mean.
It's about Ayase! Ayase!!
Huh? Is there a problem? You're close friends with her.
T-That may be true but... I have my reasons!
What reasons?
Just now, just now... Ayase saw everything!!
It doesn't matter if she sees it. Your true nature is already exposed.
But Ayase... is different.
She's not an otaku?
Yes. I was trying not to let her know!
Ah, so it's like that... my bad.
It's all your fault! Shouldn't you have informed me beforehand?!
I get it! I'm sorry!!
Ayase didn't seem to mind, but argh! This is making me mad! It's all your fault!!
I-I said I get it! I'll be careful next time!!
What's wrong? Why are you so concerned over it...?
I'm going out with Kuroneko and Saori this weekend... but it's probably better to cancel it.
Why would you? Ayase merely came over...
Because Ayase kind of found out while we were talking.
You're over-thinking it.
The mood has been spoiled... definitely.
You're quick to worry... Even then, it's not good to cancel appointments with your other friends.
That's true but...
Ayase didn't mind, so just keep that appointment.
Okay...
Kuroneko and Saori have been looking forward to hanging out with you.
G-Guess it can't be helped! Those two alone can't get things going.
So you want to put it that way. Well, whatever.
Should I meet up with Ayase at another time?
Yeah. It'll be all right if you made proper arrangements with both parties.
Oh, right. Then I'll make an appointment with Ayase.
Yes, yes.
Seems like she has done a lot of thinking...
It's good that she didn't cancel her appointment with her friends.
It would be best if Kuroneko, Saori and Ayase could get along well with each other.
A few days passed since the day I suddenly brought Ayase home and Kirino got angry.
Today is the weekend.
Kirino's supposed to have an appointment with Kuroneko and Saori.
But, for some reason she's sitting on the sofa at home...
And sulking while hugging her knees.
Hey. What are you doing?
Shut up! Go away!
What's the matter, want to talk?
Why are you asking? It has nothing to do with you.
That's not true.
This has got nothing to do with you!
Didn't you have an appointment with Kuroneko and Saori?
Why are you still at home?
I said, it has nothing to do with you!
Did you seriously think I'll just accept that? They are my friends too.
What happened?
...Don't act like a brother.
Sorry, but I'm more than a brother. I'm also a friend.
...stood.
Huh?
They stood me up.
Huh?? They stood you up? That's really strange!
It's true. They didn't come to our meeting point, and they didn't pick up my calls...
Hey hey, this can't be true...
Kirino puffed up her cheeks in silence while hugging her knees, as if she didn't want to continue talking.
Looks like she really got stood up.
When you called, they didn't pick up?
...Yes.
Got it. I'll try calling them.
It's not from your number, so maybe they'll answer.
Wait, I left my phone in my room. Wait here for a moment. I'll go make the call.
She didn't reply, but silently nodded in response.
All right, now to go back to my room and call the two of them.
I went back to the room and took my phone. First, I'll try calling Kuroneko.
Hello, is that Kuroneko?
You know, today's appointment with Kirino...
H-Hey... What on earth happened...
If it's Saori...
This time, I'll call Saori.
The ringing went on two, three times, almost going into voice mail when she finally picked up.
...Kyousuke-shi.
Finally, you finally picked it up!
Hey, Saori. About today...
Eh! Wa-Wait a moment?!
Not only Kuroneko, but even Saori hung up on me?
Furthermore, just as I mentioned today's event.
Something must have happened.
And if there's a cause behind this...
It can only be that person.
For now, I'll go talk to her...
When I returned to the living room, Kirino was still sitting on the sofa hugging her knees.
I made the calls.
Kirino glanced at me for a second, before returning to hugging her knees.
I sat in front of her, and looked straight at her.
However, Kirino didn't look back at me.
I called both Kuroneko and Saori.
And...
I asked about today.
But they hung up without a word.
Eh...
Did you do something?
Wha-What do you mean! Are you saying it's my fault?!
Isn't it a little extreme for them to hang up without saying anything?
I don't know! I didn't do anything!!
Really? Did you offend them while you were chatting?
It's normal for that black one to get angry, isn't it?
Well, that's true...
Why is it my fault? I'm the one who got stood up!
Even Saori also didn't say a word...
I don't know! I didn't do anything!
Suspecting your sister, you're unbelievable!
Huh...
It's definitely not my fault!
Looks like there's no point in asking further...
The atmosphere's unpleasant if I stay here with her, might as well head back to my room first.
Even if I continue to question Kirino, nothing will get solved.
Kuroneko and Saori won't talk to me.
...What's going on...
While I'm mumbling to myself, I thought of Ayase.
Ayase is Kirino's close friend, so she might know what's going on.
For now, I'll try contacting her.
Bringing up my phone's address book, I called Ayase.
After several rings, a familiar voice filled my ears.
Yes, hello.
Ah, Ayase. It's me, Kyousuke.
Onii-san, what is it?
Well, I have something regarding Kirino to ask you.
Kirino...?
No no, don't get suspicious of me. Recently, she's been acting strangely.
Is... that so?
Yes. That's why I thought I should ask you.
So it's like that. I thought it definitely was...
What do you mean by definitely?
Nothing.
Is that so...
Well, it must be the usual.
I can't fall to this.
Well, it's regarding Kirino...
Um, is Kirino currently at home?
Yes, she is.
Is there something that is hard for you to say?
Yes.
A heavy sigh came from the other side of the phone call.
From this alone, I can tell something happened between Kirino and her.
I understand, let's go somewhere else.
Then, could you come to the park?
The nearby park?
Yes, there.
Understood. I'll be right there.
Please do. See you.
Yep, see you.
Although she had a serious tone, even if she's reluctant, she would tell me what happened.
What on earth has happened to her...
For now, I have to talk to Ayase.
Oh...
Ayase's already here way before me.
As I came closer, Ayase noticed me and lowered her gaze.
Thanks for specially making your way here, Onii-san.
It's all right. Let's sit down first.
Okay.
We sat side by side on the park bench, but none of us spoke a word.
Hey, regarding Kirino...
Right.
Actually... recently, she's been singled out in school...
Huh? Kirino's getting excluded?
Yes, that's right. Although I don't know why.
You must be joking. How would she get excluded?
I also find that strange...
She's excellent in class, and is the center of it, unlike me.
Furthermore, she's apparently the leader of the most conspicuous group in class.
So how did she get excluded?
Whatever happened, I have no idea.
I see...
Even so, I believe in Kirino.
Ayase...!
No matter what happens, I will believe in Kirino and protect her.
Thank you, Ayase. Can I entrust Kirino to you during school time?
Yes. Leave it to me!
Kirino will definitely be all right if you are with her.
I'm proud to be able to hear that from Onii-san.
It's nothing. Please take care of Kirino.
I will.
But if that's the case, I guess I can't tell Ayase about Kuroneko and Saori.
I can't give her more trouble.
--I have to deal with this myself.
A few days after Kuroneko and Saori stood Kirino up.
I asked the two of them out on another day.
Although they seemed pretty reluctant about it, they accepted it when I said Kirino had to go for her modelling job.
Although we met to talk things over...
Both of them are saying nothing at allllll...
Usually Saori jump starts the conversation, but she didn't even do that today.
I guess it's up to me to do it then.
Okay! There's no point in keeping quiet, so I'll cut to the chase.
What... is it?
What happened between Kirino and you guys?
Both of them stayed silent, not replying.
Kuroneko didn't even look at me.
If it's going to be like that, I won't be able to ask what happened.
A-Apart from that, Kyousuke-shi, the next new release-
We'll talk about that later.
O-Okay.
Hey, what happened? Tell me.
Well... that...
You can't say it? Did she do something?
Why would you think that...?
Because she causes more trouble than not. Especially when she's together with you.
Heh... that's an accurate judgement, Nii-san.
That's Kiririn-shi's brother for you.
Now's not the time for this. What really happened?
If she did anything wrong, I'll get her to apologize, and after that, please get along well...
...That's not it.
Eh?
I said... that's not it.
Ku-Kuroneko-shi...
It would only get troublesome if we remain silent. So we should just say it.
That, that's right.
After exchanging glances, both of them had troubled expressions on their faces.
But, it seems like they are finally going to tell me.
That woman didn't do anything...
Eh...
However, we can't stay together.
What happened? I don't understand at all.
Kiririn-shi really didn't do anything, and nothing really happened.
Th-Then why did you guys...
If we stay together, that woman will get into trouble.
It's like that.
...like what?
Hmph... you still want to interfere despite knowing my true strength? Or do you have another goal in mind...?
Kuroneko-shi, if you go on, it won't be an explanation any longer.
That's true. Then I will explain simply.
Kyousuke-shi, please take a look at this.
What?
As Saori spoke, she took out her mobile phone.
After pressing a few buttons, she passed it to me. Seems like she wants me to take a look at the screen.
Taking a proper look at the screen, it seems to be displaying an email.
Can I read it?
Yes.
By the way, the sender is unknown. Kuroneko-shi's mobile phone also received the same email.
This is...
If you continue to associate with Kirino Kousaka, then something bad will happen to her.
If you care about her, then break off all relations with Kirino Kousaka.
W-What's this...
An email threat...
I don't know how that person got our email addresses, but this is definitely malicious.
So that was why you guys cancelled the appointment...
I have to apologize for not showing up for the appointment without explaining. But after receiving such a mail, it's not possible for me to go.
That's true... and it's also not possible to explain the situation.
I'm really sorry...
Saori lowered her head, while Kuroneko folded her arms with arrogance at her side.
Although it feels like usual, I can see that their expressions are different from normal.
It's not of my concern if something bad happens to her.
However, if something bad really happens to her, it won't feel good.
Sorry for making you worry.
How could I be worried for that woman?
I got it. Thank you.
I have no idea why you thanked me.
Although she appears to be angry, she's actually worried about Kirino.
If she wasn't, she wouldn't have come here to talk to me.
But coming to that, what's up with the email...
We don't understand it at all either.
And we don't know how our email addresses got leaked either.
Do you really not know who the sender is?
I don't know. It's hard to trace since the email was sent from a sub-address.
It seems like a troublesome issue.
Honestly...
What in the world is this...
What does this mean?
What is happening to Kirino?
Could it be... a stalker?
Anyway, with this situation, we can't contact Kiririn-shi...
Well, it's not like I keep in contact with that woman anyway.
Sorry to both of you.
It's okay. As long as we don't do anything, there shouldn't be problems.
You should be more concerned about your sister.
That's right.
Please take care of Kiririn-shi. Although it's pretty lonely to be unable to meet up for a while.
It's all right, isn't it? We get to not meet with that woman.
When all this is settled, let's all meet up.
Yeah.
Hmph... only if that woman wants to meet.
Okay, I got it.
To not let the two of them worry, I have to settle our matters by myself.
To do that, I need to find the cause.
...Although I'm reluctant to do this, I have to start with asking Kirino.
Hey, Kirino.
...What is it?
I want to talk with you.
Is that so. Come in.
Okay.
Since she let me in, I obediently went inside, and sat on the cat cushion.
Upon seeing this, Kirino breathed angrily with folded arms.
...So? What is it?
I met with Kuroneko and Saori.
...! H-Hmph! So what?
I asked them about what happened before.
It doesn't matter, does it? Those people!
You really think that way?
N-None of your-
Wrong! Listen closely. I asked them why they didn't show up for the appointment then.
W-Why... was that so?
Both of them received threatening emails.
If you continue to associate with Kirino Kousaka, then something bad will happen to her.
W-What is this...
Because they treated you as an important friend, that's why they didn't meet with you, not even contacting you.
That's why, at that time, both of them...
Yup. They didn't stand you up for no reason.
Saori and Kuroneko both apologized.
Although Kuroneko didn't say it directly...
Well, let's just do it this way.
Say, do you know anything about this? Any idea why this kind of email was sent?
I wouldn't know anything about this! I also want to know the reason behind this!
Did something... happen to you too?
I also received... a similar email...
What did you say?!
Kirino silently took out her phone, then passed it to me.
I looked at the screen of her sparkling decorated phone.
There was an email similar to what Saori showed me.
If you continue to associate with your friends, they will meet with danger.
If you care about your friends, stop meeting with them.
The sender is unknown?
Yes. Did the black one and Saori receive the same thing?
Yep. With the exact same contents.
What in the world is happening...!
This is going too far, even for a prank.
...It might not just be a prank.
Why do you say that?
Even when I change email addresses several times, I receive a copy of it every hour.
Huh...?
I don't understand it anymore!  No matter how much I change my address, it still comes!
Not only that, after changing addresses, it's not days, but hours before it comes again!
Hey hey, what is this?
I don't get it! Why am I getting this kind of thing?!
Well, I don't understand this situation.
How should I deal with this issue...
After learning about the situation regarding the email, the threatening emails continued to plague Kirino.
Changing email addresses didn't work.
Using sub-addresses didn't work either.
It's completely mystifying how the email addresses get leaked.
Threatening emails streamed persistently.
Stop it already... what is it? What is happening...
The continuing stream of threatening emails is starting to break down Kirino.
It seems to me that these threatening emails won't be stopping anytime soon.
Although she usually has her phone beside her, now she doesn't even want to be near it.
...Hii!
Another email?
I-I don't want it... the ringing is scary...
I'll take a look. Is that okay?
Y-Yes...
I take the ringing phone from her, and look at the screen.
It says "You have mail".
Upon seeing that, my eyebrows are raised naturally.
You changed address just a while ago too...
Geez... what is it? What, what is it? What?!
Calm down. I'll delete it for you.
I just changed it! I only told my friends! How?!
Calm down! It's all right!
How can I calm down?! I can't calm down at all! I don't get it! What is it! What can it be!!
I have to change address... otherwise he knows. I must change it quickly.
Hey, Kirino.
This time, I have to change it to something no one knows. A long and complicated one that no one could know...
*sigh*...
With numbers and alphabets and symbols... and even longer...!
...This happens every time another email comes.
Every time a new email comes, she changes her address and immediately tells her friends.
But nothing will get solved if we keep repeating the same thing.
This time, it will definitely... he, hehehe...
Kirino, are you okay?
Yes, but what if it comes again... No. It won't come. It won't come... This time for sure.
Because of that email, Kirino hasn't been meeting with her friends.
She's afraid that her friends will meet the same fate.
She's been enduring this on her own.
She hardly listens to my words.
Eep!!!
It's all right. Seems like someone's here.
Y-You go get the door!
I got it.
I got a shock after I opened the door.
Why? Because Ayase came.
Sorry for bothering, Onii-san.
A-Ayase...
Erm, is Kirino in?
Yes, but what is it?
Kirino keeps changing her email address recently, so I got worried...
Ah, that's it. She lets her friends know whenever she changes her email address.
She's been changing it too frequently, so I'm worried. Furthermore, I received an email just now...
Ah...
Kirino is in, right? Then, I'll come in.
I understand. She's in the living room.
Okay! Excuse me.
I followed Ayase into the living room, and in there Ayase saw Kirino with a frightened expression on her face.
W-Why is... Ayase here...?
Because I'm worried about you... sending emails about changing addresses every day.
Y-You can't. Ayase, you can't come over!
...Kirino?
You can't associate with me.
Why are you saying such things?
Because if you associate with me, bad things will happen to you. And if something bad happens to you because of me...
Who said such things? It's impossible for something bad to happen to me if I associate with you.
B-Because... every day the emails... even after changing addresses...
That's why you send those emails each day...
That's why you can't stay! Ayase, go back! You can't come over ever again!
...Kirino, don't worry.
A-Ayase...
Ayase went close to the frightened Kirino and hugged her gently.
Kirino calmed down a little from her disarrayed state.
But it was only for a moment.
You can't! You can't, Ayase! Definitely not!!
It's all right! It's all right, Kirino.
Attempting to pacify Kirino, Ayase held her tightly and rubbed her on her back.
Ayase... W-Why...?
No matter what happens, I won't betray you. I will always protect you.
A-Ayase...
So calm down. You don't have to worry.
Ayase... Ayase...
To be unable to rely on anyone, it must feel uneasy... Sorry, I should have came over earlier.
A-Ayase...
It's all right already. I'm with you. Because I like you a lot.
Ayase...! *sob*, *sobsob*, I... I...! I was scared... I was scared this whole time.
While being hugged by Ayase, Kirino cried.
Huge tears fell from her eyes, while Ayase held her tightly without letting go.
This is the first time I saw Kirino like that.
And also the first time I realized how weak Kirino is.
Ayase... Ayase...
Yup...
Only Ayase understands me...! Ayase's the only one I have left...!
No matter what happens, I'll always be by your side. I'll even take the share of other friends, and always be with you.
Yeah... Ayase... Ayase...
Ayase gently patted the head of Kirino who's breaking down crying.
She had a calm, kind expression on her face, just like a saint.
While looking at that calm expression, I suddenly realized.
It could have been a stalker, but the person who sent the threatening emails seemed to be able to find out the new addresses.
Furthermore, he not only knew about Kirino's normal friends, but also the addresses of her hidden friends, Kuroneko and Saori.
How does he know that?
There can only be one reason. He had to have seen Kirino's phone.
Then, who would be able to have access to Kirino's phone?
...It's all right, Kirino.
I remember, a while ago Kirino said that Ayase borrowed her phone to do matching decorations.
From then on, Kirino's phone became flashy and sparkling.
That is, the phone was entrusted to Ayase, and she gave it matching decorations.
Can       it        be     ?
I glanced at Ayase for a moment. Ayase was still holding Kirino and rubbing her back.
Looking at this scene, I can't help but break out in cold sweat.
No, can it be... but... it can only be...
...hehe.
Although I didn't want to consider this, the most probable thing is...
No, I better stop. I'm over-thinking it...
Even it is very likely, there's no proof for it.
Since she's so concerned for Kirino, it can't be that...
Although I kept thinking that way, that expression of Ayase kept floating in my mind.
